summary: Sinak Airport is a small highland airfield serving the remote community of Sinak in the Papua region of Indonesia. It functions primarily as a lifeline connecting isolated mountain settlements to larger regional hubs across Papua. The airport operates in a rugged tropical highland environment and supports light aircraft and general aviation traffic.
